## Email a branded PDF receipt after a Stripe payment with ASHDOCS Generate PDF

Shops, course creators and service businesses that take payments with Stripe and want to send their own branded PDF receipt, without building a PDF service.

### How it works
1. The **Stripe Trigger** fires on `payment_intent.succeeded`.
2. **Receipt details** formats the amount (zero-decimal currencies such as JPY included), date and customer, and escapes anything that came from Stripe.
3. **Build receipt HTML** fills a clean, inline-styled receipt template with your business name from **Settings**.
4. **Generate PDF** (ASHDOCS) renders the HTML to a PDF file.
5. Gmail emails the PDF to the customer. If Gmail fails, you get an email about it instead.

### Requirements
- An ASHDOCS account (https://www.ashdocs.com/?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=stripe-receipt-pdf). Works on every ASHDOCS plan, including Free (100 credits a month).
- A Stripe account
- A Gmail account
- Self-hosted n8n with the community node `n8n-nodes-ashdocs` installed

[ASHDOCS](https://www.ashdocs.com/?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=stripe-receipt-pdf) · [Docs](https://www.ashdocs.com/docs)

## Setup
**Plan:** Works on every ASHDOCS plan, including Free (100 credits a month).

1. Create an ASHDOCS account at https://www.ashdocs.com/?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=stripe-receipt-pdf and create an API key on the **API Keys** page of the dashboard. A test key makes watermarked test invoices while you try the workflow.
2. Install the ASHDOCS community node: **Settings → Community nodes → Install**, enter `n8n-nodes-ashdocs`. Then open any ASHDOCS node and create the **ASHDOCS API** credential with your key.
3. Connect Stripe in **Stripe payment succeeded** (a restricted key with read access to PaymentIntents and write access to webhook endpoints is enough). n8n registers the Stripe webhook when you activate the workflow.
4. Connect Gmail in **Email receipt** and **Tell me it failed**.
5. Fill in **Settings**: business name, address, and the support email shown on the receipt (failure alerts go there too).
6. Make sure your checkout collects an email: the receipt goes to `receipt_email`, or to `metadata.email` if you set that instead.

## Customize - Restyle the receipt in **Build receipt HTML** (it is plain HTML and CSS); add your logo with an `` tag pointing to a public image URL. - Change the paper size in **Generate PDF** (A4 or Letter). - Also save the PDF to Google Drive or attach it to a CRM record.
